title: Contacts becomes Leads
change: Contacts becomes Leads. Each row is a person who sent a form or watched a page, with that page, how much of the video they watched and what they asked. Import CSV, Add Contact and the CRM columns go; Export stays.
evidence: 1 contact added by hand in 30 days, and no CSV imports since March 2025.
notes: Sam Patel shows Watched only: he watched but sent no form, and Clarity knows him because the page was sent to him. Page thumbnails use the page’s video poster. Learn stays in the sidebar here because that cut belongs to another change.
